{{samename|handheld encyclopedia owned by {{Ash}}, also nicknamed Dexter|Pokédex#In animation|Pokédex}} {{CharInfobox| |color={{contest color}} |corecolor={{contest color light}} |bordercolor={{contest color dark}} |name=Dexter |jname=ビック |tmname=Vick |image=Judge Dexter DPA.png |size=200px |caption=Dexter in [[Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!]] |hometown=Unknown |region=[[Sinnoh]] |game=yes |generation={{gen|IV}} |games={{game3|Diamond and Pearl|Diamond, Pearl|s}}, {{v2|Platinum}} |gender=Male }} '''Dexter''' (Japanese: '''ビック''' ''Vick'') is a character in {{game2|Diamond|Pearl|Platinum}}. He is the [[Contest announcer|announcer]] and one of the [[Contest Judge|judges]] of the [[Pokémon Super Contest]]s. His appearance is designed after the {{tc|Gentleman}} {{DL|Pokémon Trainer|Trainer class}}. ==In the core series games== [[File:Super Contest.png|thumb|left|Dexter in the games]] Dexter appears as the [[Contest announcer|master of ceremonies]] and one of the [[Pokémon Super Contest]] [[Contest Judge|Judges]] in [[Hearthome City]], [[Sinnoh]] in {{game2|Diamond|Pearl|Platinum}}. He appears to be a kind man who genuinely enjoys his work, despite limited interaction with the {{player}}. His input appears to be somewhat more important in the [[Appeal|Acting Competition]] than [[Keira]]'s or [[Jordan]]'s, as raising his Voltage to maximum gains the {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}'s {{pkmn|Coordinator}} eight points instead of five. Also, he sits in the center of the three judges and has a heart under his name. His appearance looks somewhat different in the {{pkmn|games}} to the {{pkmn|manga}}. In the games, he appears as a somewhat tall man with a full head of white hair, wearing a bow-tie. {{left clear}} ===Sprites=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; font-size: 80%; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{contest color dark}}; background: #{{contest color}}" |- | style="{{roundy|80px}} border: 2px solid #{{contest color dark}}; background: #{{contest color light}}; width:96px; height:96px"| [[File:Gentleman DPPt OD.png]] |- | Overworld sprite from
{{color2|000|Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Versions|Diamond, Pearl}}, and {{color2|000|Pokémon Platinum Version|Platinum}} |} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Dexter Adventures.png|thumb|245px|Dexter in Pokémon Adventures]] ===={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}==== Dexter was first seen in the [[Hearthome City]] [[Contest Hall]] when {{adv|Platinum}} arrived and determinedly swore an oath to partake in the next day's {{pkmn|Super Contest}}. After {{adv|Diamond}} was given a [[Poffin Case]] and created various mixes of excellent [[Poffin]]s for her that brought up {{TP|Platinum|Prinplup}}'s [[Cool (condition)|Coolness]] stat high, which impressed Dexter, she saw opposition in several jealous contestants whose intervention nearly had her backing out before Diamond brought her spirits up, after which she managed to win nevertheless, utilizing a combination of {{m|Bubble}}, {{m|Metal Claw}}, {{m|Ice Beam}}, and {{m|Peck}}. A young Dexter was later seen in a picture with a younger [[Johanna]] in Diamond's home. He was also seen with his fellow judges at the [[Lost Tower]] after having been sent there because of the fight between {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}} that caused time and space to distort. ===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!=== Dexter appeared in ''[[DPA06|Beauty Contest: The Pokémon Super Contest!!]]'', where he was seen judging the {{pkmn|Super Contest}} that [[Hareta]] and {{OBP|Jun|DPA}} had entered. He was highly tolerant of their antics, which included being hit by a {{m|Brine}} and {{m|Peck}} combination by [[Hareta's Piplup]]. However, when [[Jun (DPA)#Staraptor|Jun's Staravia]] blew his hat off with {{m|Whirlwind}}, exposing his bald head, he lost his temper and disqualified both Jun and Hareta from the competition. ==Trivia== * His name is shared with {{Ash}}'s [[Pokédex]]. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{contest color}}; border:3px solid #{{contest color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{contest color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{contest color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{contest color light}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | ビック ''Vick'' | |- | English, German
